name: OMAN Oil- Pref. SAOG
description: OMAN Oil- Pref. SAOG (OOMP) represents the listed preferred share class of Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG (OOMS / OOMCO) on the MSX Regular Market, comprising 3.225 million preferred shares (OMR 322.5 thousand paid-up capital) wholly held by OQ SAOC rather than a separate operating entity. The underlying operating company, Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG (established 2003 and consolidated under OIA-owned OQ SAOC), is one of Oman's premier fuel marketers operating 241 domestic retail service stations alongside aviation fueling, B2B commercial fuels, marine bunkering, and international lubricant lines (Optimo, Maximo, Gear Guard). In 9M 2026, the underlying OOMCO Group expanded revenue 15.5% YoY to OMR 727 million and doubled net profit after tax to OMR 11.6 million.
highlights: Preferred share class (3.225 million shares, OMR 322.5K paid-up capital) of Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG (OOMS), 100% held by parent holding company OQ SAOC.
